summary: A hover tooltip, light or dark, positionable on any side, with an optional arrow.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger's content, an icon usually. Pair it with `triggerLabel` when there is no text.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The trigger's `aria-label`. An icon-only trigger has no accessible name without it.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A key or chord after the text, drawn as a keycap.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger the tooltip opens on. It flips automatically if there is no room.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the trigger and the tooltip, or its arrow tip, in pixels.

props.name: arrow
props.description: A pointer notched into the tooltip's edge, aimed back at the trigger. It re-aims itself when `side` changes.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long a hover must rest before it opens, in ms. Set to `0` to open on contact.

props.name: tone
props.description: The tooltip's surface and its trigger together. `light` and `dark` are the two neutral surfaces; `danger` reads red at both ends, for a destructive action.

props.name: animated
props.description: The tooltip's fade and rise. Turn it off for an instant tooltip, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popup is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`, which is right almost always; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame or a container that owns its own stacking context.
